items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 7
items.summary: Kicker Brandon McManus (2009-12) made his return to the NFL this Sunday as he was signed by the Los Angeles Rams earlier in the week. While he did not attempt a field goal in the game, he was perfect in PAT attempts going 5/5. The Rams went on to defeat the Raiders, 35-21.

items.title: Game Guide: East Carolina
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football returns from its bye week on Saturday, October 31, traveling to Greenville, N.C., for an American Conference matchup with East Carolina. Kickoff at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium is set for 3:00 p.m. ET on ESPN+. Fans can listen at OwlSports.com/listen.

items.title: Denzel Chavis: The Importance of Brotherhood
items.summary: While Denzel Chavis brings plenty of energy and personality to the Temple Owls Football team, he understands that leadership goes beyond what he says. For him, it's just as much about his own habits and making sure that he's setting the right example.

items.title: Keeler Announces Temple Football Staff Changes
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football head coach K.C. Keeler announced several staff changes during the team's bye week on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 6
items.summary: It was a career day for Eagles linebacker Arnold Ebiketie (2017-20) on Sunday afternoon. With multiple linebackers sidelined, Ebiketie stepped up, recording a career-high nine tackles. Despite his performance, the Eagles fell to the Panthers, 25-14.

items.title: Game Time Announced for Temple Football at East Carolina
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – The American Conference announced Monday afternoon that on Saturday, Oct. 31 the contest between the Temple Owls and East Carolina Pirates in Greenville, N.C. will kickoff at 3:00 p.m.

items.title: Clarke Makes History; Football Falls to Charlotte
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA - Temple football fell to Charlotte, 38-31, Saturday at Lincoln Financial Field. The Owls dropped to 2-5 overall and 1-2 in American Conference play, while the 49ers earned their first win of the season to move to 1-6 and 1-2 in conference action.

items.title: Joseph Auzenne’s Impact Goes Beyond the Numbers
items.summary: When emotions run high on the football field, Temple defensive lineman Joseph Auzenne is often the one reminding his teammates to stay focused on what comes next.

items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 5
items.summary: It was a Monday Night Football thriller as left tackle Dion Dawkins (2013-16), running back Ray Davis (2019-20), safety Sam Franklin (2016-19), and the Buffalo Bills defeated the Los Angeles Rams on a walk-off field goal in overtime. Davis set the tone early, returning the opening kickoff 70 yards to the Rams' 26-yard line to set up an eventual field goal. He also hauled in a 31-yard reception in the fourth quarter

items.title: Date for Temple Football at Memphis Announced by American Conference
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – The American Conference announced Monday afternoon that the Temple Owls and Memphis Tigers will meet on Friday, Nov. 27 for their week 12 contest.
